lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The distance between centroids increases significantly as the pattern progresses toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroids of the lateral blobs, forming a visible grid-like network across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is observed along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from the darker dorsal surface to the lighter lateral pattern.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-intensity spots, primarily located on the lower half of the fin's visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated parasitic organisms (likely remoras) are attached to the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin. Small irregular white abrasions are visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a unique dense patterning of small-diameter spots, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the main body flank.
